name: com.mingyuechunqiu.recordermanager.feature.main.container.RecordVideoActivity
description: This is part of Muxiaolin's RecorderManager video-recording library. RecorderManager opens this screen for the app's video-recording flow; it checks recording permissions, captures a clip, and returns its file location and duration when confirmed.
disableEffect: The app cannot use RecorderManager's video-capture screen to record and return a clip.
